column3: Close to the Hebrew; “set your heart” is rendered “mark well.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to rebellion” is rendered “to the rebellious,” and “[it is] enough for you” “let us have no more.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sons of foreignness” is rendered “foreigners.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you appointed [them] as keepers” is rendered “you have set others to keep charge.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I lift up my hand against them” is rendered “I have raised My hand in an oath against them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the holy things of the holy things” is rendered “the Most Holy Place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and inside” is rendered “or within the house.”
Close to the Hebrew; “on their loins” is rendered “on their bodies,” and “with sweat” “with anything that causes sweat.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will not consecrate the people by their clothes” is rendered “in their holy garments they shall not sanctify the people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the widow who is a widow from a priest” is rendered “widows of priests.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV moves “into the inner court” to the offering (“he must offer his sin offering in the inner court”).
Close to the Hebrew; “it will become for them an inheritance” is rendered “in regard to their inheritance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “devoted thing” is rendered “dedicated thing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every contribution” is rendered “every sacrifice,” and “your dough” “your ground meal.”
